prayer: Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for issuance of a writ of mandamus directing the third and fourth respondents to initiate action under Section 216 of the District Municipalities Act, 1920 and Section 56 of Tamil Nadu Town and Country Planning Act, 1971 as against the unauthorized commercial buildings constructed by the fifth to eighth respondents in Palaniyandavarpuram Colony, Gnanagiri Road, Sivakasi Town and consequently directing the third and fourth respondents to demolish the unauthorized commercial buildings constructed by the fifth to eighth respondents within the time that may be stipulated by this Court.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

N. Sathish Kumar, J.:— Though this Writ Petition has been filed seeking a direction to remove the unauthorised construction, namely, the commercial buildings, on the ground that the fifth to eighth respondents have constructed the said buildings in an area earmarked for residential purposes, the counter affidavit and the typed set of papers filed by the petitioner, wherein the building plan has been annexed, clearly show that the fifth to eighth respondents have obtained the necessary planning permission from the competent authorities.

2. In view of the above, this Writ Petition is dismissed. No costs. Consequently, the connected Miscellaneous Petitions are closed.
